ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature along the outer lobe margins, terminating in sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake mark scarring on the left lobe distal edge; irregular trailing edge erosion on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Feathered pixel intensity transition between black and white zones on the distal lobes.
